mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Defines Unix-socket protocol mode for receiving syslog messages locally.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute path to the Unix socket file (e.g. /tmp/in_syslog). Required for unix_tcp/unix_udp.

unix_perm.title: Unix Socket Permissions
unix_perm.description: Permission of the Unix socket file. Only applies to unix_tcp or unix_udp modes.

buffer_chunk_size.title: Buffer Chunk Size
buffer_chunk_size.description: Buffer size for incoming syslog messages. For UDP modes, this is the only way to configure receive buffer.

buffer_max_size.title: Buffer Max Size
buffer_max_size.description: Maximum buffer size to receive a syslog message. Defaults to buffer_chunk_size if not set.

receive_buffer_size.title: Receive Buffer Size
receive_buffer_size.description: Maximum socket receive buffer size. Important for high-volume UDP/unix_udp to prevent message loss. On Linux, capped by sysctl net.core.rmem_max.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Alternative parser for the message. Default is syslog-rfc5424 for tcp/udp, syslog-rfc3164-local for unix modes. Use syslog-rfc5424 for fractional seconds.

raw_message_key.title: Raw Message Key
raw_message_key.description: Key where the original raw syslog message will be preserved.

source_address_key.title: Source Address Key
source_address_key.description: Key where the source address will be injected.

threaded.title: Threaded
threaded.description: Run this input plugin in its own thread.
